name: Ord Cestus
description: Ord Cestus, also referred to as simply Cestus, was a planet in the D'Astan sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Located in the vicinity of the Perlemian Trade Route, it was situated a considerable distance away from common routes between Geonosis and Coruscant. During the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic established a medical station near Ord Cestus.
